verdict.rationale: Pulley documents e-signature collection for agreements like SAFEs (board/investor signatures) and confirms it acts as transfer agent, implying stock issuance is tracked in-platform, but no evidence directly describes issuing electronic share certificates with in-platform legal signing permanently linked to the cap table entry. missing for 10: explicit documentation of share certificate generation/e-signing workflow, evidence of permanent linkage between a signed certificate and its cap table record, and confirmation this applies beyond SAFEs to common stock/RSAs.
